note: The closed list of reasons a tree may NOT go live. Hidde ruled it on 2026-08-10 after three separate over-strictness corrections in one session: a missing age, a modest girth and being ninth in line had each been used to hold trees back, and none of them is a reason. His words: 'can you never ever stop a tree from going live if you're not sure about the size, it doesn't matter at all if you are wrong.'
how: This file is data so that no run has to remember the list, and so that adding to it is a visible change rather than a judgement made in a research pass. scripts/leads.py classifies every lead against it and passcheck's brief prints the result. Adding a reason here needs Hidde.
fail_open_note: THE IMPORTANT PART. A lead whose reason matches nothing here is treated as PUBLISHABLE, never as blocked. The old default was the opposite and it buried 142 already-researched trees behind reasons that were never valid, at roughly 19k tokens each to find them in the first place. When in doubt, a tree ships flagged; the reader is the correction layer.

blocking.label: dead or gone
blocking.why: The product is standing in front of something alive. A dead entry makes the years-counter lie.

blocking.label: private land or access-restricted
blocking.why: Hard rule 10. Never send anyone to a locked gate or someone's garden.

blocking.label: location deliberately withheld by its source
blocking.why: Hard rule 10. People who know the tree hid it to protect it; we do not undo that.

blocking.label: not a single collectible point
blocking.why: Hidde, 2026-07-26 and confirmed 2026-08-10. An avenue has nothing to stand at and nothing to have seen.

blocking.label: no location at all
blocking.why: Location is the one field that cannot be corrected after someone has already walked to the wrong place (Hidde, 2026-08-10). Note the narrowness: an APPROXIMATE pin that says it is approximate does NOT block. Only a tree we cannot place at all does.

never_blocking: no age, or an uncertain or approximate age
modest girth, height or spread; not the biggest in its park
a judgement that it is not remarkable enough
only one source (Step 2 says publish it flagged, with a note)
an approximate pin, as long as it is labelled approximate
the city already has ten, or this was ninth in line
nobody got round to researching it further
